name: adopt-ai-job-aid
description: Builds one card for one AI task with five fixed fields (when to use AI, what to give it, what to check, what never goes in, who to ask), in a format picked by task shape, with its place in the workflow, an owner and a review date. Use for "run adopt-ai-job-aid", "AI job aid", "AI cheat sheet for this task", "quick reference card for using AI", "one-pager for using AI on this task", "AI checklist instead of a course", "people need the answer mid-task", part of the Claude Guide for AI Adoption Pack by 90n.
